dct_title_s: Plan for the re-arrangement of the walks and plantings at Van Cleve Park, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan for the re-arrangement of the walks and plantings at Van Cleve Park, Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Twenty-ninth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 118.
